_band.note: Mirrors scripts/verify-steps/CLAIMED-NUMBERS.json for migration timestamps. Claim-before-author required.

_how_to_claim: Open a claim-only PR (chore/claim-migration-YYYYMMDDHHMM-*) that adds the timestamp to 'claimed' below; merge to origin/main; THEN author the .sql file on a feature branch. CI fails if a new db/migrations/*.sql timestamp is not already claimed on origin/main. Same-lane intra-branch collisions are prevented because the registry is merged before the migration file exists.
_why: 202612350000 was claimed twice by two concurrently-open CC-1 branches. The migration lane-band guard (HH 00–11 / 12–23) only prevents inter-lane collisions; it cannot see two unmerged branches in the same lane. A registry merged before authorship converts the invisible race into a git conflict.
